description: This plot illustrates the Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy across varying Q_pop frequency values. The x-axis is labeled "Q_pop frequency (x10^4)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with a visible labeled range from 0.0 to 1.0, featuring tick marks at intervals of 0.2, though the grid lines and data points extend above this range. The "Initial Accuracy" is represented by a solid green line with square markers and vertical error bars. It begins at an x-value of 1 with an accuracy of approximately 0.38, rises to a local peak at x=5 with a value of 0.65, declines to 0.5 at x=7, and then generally increases to reach 0.9 at x=13. It then dips slightly and remains steady at 0.85 for x=15 and x=17, before ending at x=19 with a value of approximately 0.95. The "Final Accuracy" is depicted by a dashed blue line with circular markers and vertical error bars. It starts at x=1 with a value of approximately 0.7, increases to 1.0 at x=5, and experiences a decline to approximately 0.92 at x=7. The line then fluctuates, rising to 1.1 at x=9, dropping to 1.0 at x=11, and rising again to reach 1.2 at x=15. After a minor dip to approximately 1.15 at x=17, it concludes at its highest point of 1.4 at x=19.
